patterns.description: Slide pairs a left-aligned title with a vertical stack of three feature cards on the right, each card combining an icon badge with a heading paragraph and a body paragraph.
Placeholder text 'Заголовок' and 'Текст' across the title and cards indicates a reusable generation template rather than final content.
Fixed VK Workspace branding logos are inherited from both the master and layout layers at the bottom-left and should remain unchanged.
